Wawayanda Town Court is a justice court government institute in State Hill, New York. This court hears and solves mostly Traffic and criminal cases in the Town. The district attorney's offices mostly take criminal cases. The court is one of the busiest Traffic courts in Orange County, having a Traffic ticket written as I-84. This court also hears some civil, small claims, and code violations cases. It also contains a dropbox for public convenience. The business hours are 9:00 am to 4:00 pm five days a week.

division

Wawayanda Town Court division consists of the following:

  • Traffic Division
  • Criminal Division
  • Civil Division
  • Small Claims Division
  • Code Violation Division

Primarily Traffic and criminal division cases are heard and solved by this court.

Case Information

Wawayanda Town Court case information can be found online in some cases by using the first and last Name with city or state. In some cases, records are only obtained from the court by writing specific records, describing the records reasonably sought, verifying court indexing and record retrieval system, and giving all necessary information to the court that is related to the case.

Traffic Division

Wawayanda Town Court Traffic division handles and solves Traffic related cases like moving vehicle violations, speed exceeds, accidents, etc. I-84, route 6, 17M, and 284 NY routes tickets are issued by the Traffic division. In some Traffic cases, it is mandatory to appear in court, but in some cases pleas of guilty or not guilty will be sent, and appearance is not compulsory. In Traffic, infraction trials are done before the judge or bench, but the jury is present. Suppose the fine is not paid at the due date, then license suspension occurs. Traffic court cases are heard every Monday from 4:00 pm to 5:00 pm.

Criminal Division

Waywayanda Town Court criminal division handles and solves cases related to crimes like murder, kidnapping, etc. Criminal cases require an attorney because, without an attorney, the person feels difficulty in the case. The criminal court hearing is held every second Tuesday of the month and every fourth Thursday at 3:00 pm or 4:00 pm.

Payment

Wawayanda Town Court Payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can pay a fine by visiting the court during business hours

Online

A person can pay online by using the www.paycourtonline.com website of the court. Convenience charges are applied through an online method

Mail

A Person can send a check to the mailing address of the court. The mailing address is 80 Ridgebury Hill Road, Slate Hill, NY 10973.

Phone

This court also provides the facility to pay through the phone using credit or debit for paying by phone, dial: 1-888-912-1541. Convenience charges are applied through calling.

Appearance Information

Wawayanda Town Court provides the facility to pay a fine only and not to appear in court for the case, but in some cases, it is mandatory to appear in person. If a person is charged with a misdemeanor or criminal case, then a court appearance is mandatory for the case. If the case is not a misdemeanor, it is not mandatory to appear in court. Mail the ticket with a guilty or not guilty plea and send it to the court before the case date.

Fine

Wawayanda Town Court Traffic tickets fines can be received on speeding tickets, Traffic violations, and other moving violations. The fine depends upon the type of violation you have done. For example, a minimum of $475 and a maximum of $685 fines will be on the over speeding at 21 miles per hour. All fines can be paid online.

Plea

Wawayanda Town Court plea form consists of two types of Traffic ticket information:

A plea by Guilty

Please fill out the form section A for plead Guilty and send it to the court's mailing address. The court will mail you the acceptable cost and the due date.

Plead not Guilty

Please fill out the form section B for pleading Not Guilty and send it to the court. The court will reply to you whether to appear in court or not with the fine and due date of the fine.

FAQ

What is the legal aid contact number?

The legal aid contact number is 845- 291-2454.

What will be done before entering the courtroom?

The things done before entering the courtroom are:

  • Clothes must be comfortable and perfect. Avoid loose t-shirts, torn pants, flip flops or sleeve tops, and sandals.
  • Eatable items are not allowed to eat before entering the courtroom.
  • Turn off the cell phones.
  • A child that causes disturbance in the court will be excluded from the court, so avoid bringing a child to the courtroom.
  • Talking and creating a disturbance is not allowed; if any person does this, they will be excluded from the courtroom.

What types of checks are allowed in the court for payment?

Personal or company checks are not accepted for payment in the wawayanda town court.

Which forms help you to represent yourself in New York Court?

DIY forms help you to represent yourself in the New York Court. These forms contain the case type, program, and the court that handles the case.

What should be done if I cannot afford a criminal case attorney?

You should contact the Orange county legal aid service, they will check if you qualify for their service, and then they will provide you an attorney for free or with affordable fees.

Phone: 845-291-2454

What are safety protocols for the precaution of coronavirus in this court?

Wawayanda Town Court safety protocol includes:

  • Enter the court wearing a mask and maintain social distancing
  • Every person must follow health and safety instructions.
  • All persons are required to submit the COVID-19 risk assessment inquiry and temperature screening before entering the court.

How to contact the clerk's office?

You can visit the clerk's office at 80 Ridgebury Hill Road, Slate Hill, NY 10973, or call them on 845-355-5700.

What is Wawayanda Town Hall?

Wawayanda Town Hall is a hall in the court situated in the Orange county New York western part. It is a public building.

What is a court drop box?

Wawayanda Town Court had a locked drop box available in the courtroom. It is used for the people's convenience so they can drop the Traffic violation when the court is closed for an event.
